description: This Java source file defines the ImplementationId class in the org.openmrs package, which models a unique identification entity for installations of OpenMRS. It includes fields such as name, description, implementationId, and passphrase, along with corresponding getters, setters, and overridden methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.
